Based on the provided context, the 1923 version of *The Hunchback of Notre Dame* is an American silent film produced by Universal Pictures. It was directed by Wallace Worsley and famously stars Lon Chaney in the titular role of Quasimodo, with Patsy Ruth Miller playing Esmeralda. The film premiered in early September 1923 and significantly elevated Chaney to major stardom.

<answer>A 1923 American silent film directed by Wallace Worsley and starring Lon Chaney as Quasimodo.</answer>
